related.title: Sentinel-2 多光譜觀測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付視線定義、相干遮罩、控制點殘差及解纏不確定區。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver line-of-sight definition, coherence mask, control residuals and unwrapping ambiguity zones.
related.difference: 將不同像元大小的波段配準至共同網格，保留反射率平均與品質遮罩。
related.differenceEn: Register bands of different pixel sizes to a shared grid while preserving reflectance averages and quality masks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從往返路徑 2Δd 推導相位，代入 π/2 並換算毫米。
逐格乘 100 m² 再除 400 m²，與直接平均交叉核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive phase from round-trip path 2Δd, substitute π/2 and convert to millimetres.
Multiply each value by 100 m² and divide the sum by 400 m²; cross-check the direct mean.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ICESat-2 雷射測高衛星
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付視線定義、相干遮罩、控制點殘差及解纏不確定區。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver line-of-sight definition, coherence mask, control residuals and unwrapping ambiguity zones.
related.difference: 在重複軌跡分析中扣除橫向偏移遇到地表坡度造成的假高度變化。
related.differenceEn: Remove apparent elevation change caused by cross-track displacement over sloping terrain in repeat-track analysis.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 從往返路徑 2Δd 推導相位，代入 π/2 並換算毫米。
先算坡度項 0.4 m，再從觀測 0.5 m 扣除，與剖面圖交叉核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Derive phase from round-trip path 2Δd, substitute π/2 and convert to millimetres.
Compute the 0.4 m terrain term, subtract it from 0.5 m and cross-check against the profile.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
